answer.reason: The larger figure (6,020,426 MWh) is consistent with Alaska's total net electricity generation, while IPP & CHP (independent power producers and combined heat and power) represents only a portion of that total, matching the smaller figure of 670,080 MWh.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Alaska Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 6,020,426 megawatthours
B. 670,080 megawatthours

Source citation: Alaska Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/alaska/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
